name: leetcode
description: The LeetCode platform logo mark. A stylized angular bracket intersected by a horizontal bar — the distinctive geometric mark of the LeetCode coding practice platform.

provenance.trademarkContext: Used for identification purposes only. This project has no affiliation with, endorsement by, or sponsorship from LeetCode LLC.
provenance.attribution: LeetCode mark is a trademark of LeetCode LLC.
provenance.notes: The animation treatment (path draw sequence, timing, easing) is original implementation work. The underlying LeetCode mark is a trademark of LeetCode LLC and its license status is pending human review. The animationLicense field (MIT) covers only the animation code — it does not grant permission to use the LeetCode trademark or reproduce the mark outside the terms set by LeetCode LLC. The icon.svg uses a 128×128 coordinate space rather than the trix-icons standard 24×24 viewBox; this is documented intentional deviation to preserve the exact geometry of the mark (see REGISTRY.md). Do not change reviewRequired to false without human legal review.

animation.description: The entire mark traces itself in a single continuous gesture (1.1s) using a weighted ease-in-out cubic-bezier. The fill crossfade begins 950ms in — 150ms before the draw completes — creating a slight overlap that dissolves the stroke smoothly into the final filled state.

accessibility.notes: When used as a link to a LeetCode profile or problem set, the parent element should provide context (e.g., aria-label='View on LeetCode').
